mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_oauth_identity ( account_id, provider, subject, linked_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{provider}, #{subject}, #{linkedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, provider, subject, linked_at FROM account_oauth_identity WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM account_oauth_identity WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND provider != 'KAKAO'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_oauth_identity i JOIN account a ON a.id = i.account_id WHERE i.provider = #{provider} AND i.subject = #{subject} AND a.deleted_at IS NOT NULL)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM account_oauth_identity WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND provider = 'KAKAO' AND subject = #{subject}
